title: Side‑Channel & Implementation Attacks ⚡
description: The math is perfect, but the hardware isn't. Learn how timing, power, and errors leak keys.

slides.title: Beyond the Math: Physics Leaks Keys 🧪
slides.content:
# A cipher can be mathematically unbreakable but trivially broken in practice if its implementation leaks information.

Side‑channel attacks do not attack the algorithm; they attack the **implementation**.

- **Timing attacks** – measure how long operations take.
- **Power analysis** – measure electricity consumption.
- **Electromagnetic emanations** – radio signals from the chip.
- **Cache attacks** – exploit CPU cache behaviour.

These are real‑world threats used to extract keys from smart cards, SGX enclaves, and even remote servers.

slides.title: Fault Injection & Power Analysis ⚡
slides.content:
# **Power analysis** – the power consumption of a chip depends on the operations being performed. Differential Power Analysis (DPA) correlates power traces with key guesses, breaking AES‑128 in minutes on unprotected hardware.

**Fault injection** – by glitching voltage, clock, or shining a laser, an attacker can cause a single bit‑flip during encryption. Comparing correct and faulty ciphertexts can reveal the key (Differential Fault Analysis).

These attacks are why bank cards use hardened chips, and why constant‑time, no‑branch code is essential.

slides.title: Cache Attacks (Meltdown/Spectre) 💥
slides.content: ## Even remote attackers can exploit CPU caches to leak data across isolation boundaries. Flush+Reload, Prime+Probe – these attacks measure cache timing to detect which memory was accessed. They have been used to steal AES keys from co‑located VMs.

quizData.question: Which of the following is a side‑channel attack?

options.text: Brute‑forcing a key by trying all possibilities
Measuring the time taken to encrypt to infer key bits
Decrypting a message with the correct key
Using a known plaintext to find the key

quizData.explanation: Timing analysis is a side‑channel because it exploits implementation characteristics, not mathematical flaws.
